species.name: Colugo
mustRead: gliding membrane spanning neck to fingertips to tail tip
huge round forward eyes
mottled lichen-like camouflage fur
species.note: The most complete gliding membrane of any mammal - it encloses the fingers, toes and the whole tail, unlike a flying squirrel's.

species.name: Sun Bear
mustRead: golden-cream crescent patch on the chest
short sleek jet-black coat
very long curved climbing claws and blunt short muzzle
species.note: The smallest bear - stocky and loose-skinned with a short face, not a scaled-down grizzly.

species.name: Dingo
mustRead: sandy-ginger coat with white feet
erect pointed triangular ears
lean wolfish frame with a bushy straight tail

species.name: Grizzly Bear
mustRead: muscular hump over the shoulders
dished concave facial profile
long pale front claws and grizzled fur
species.note: The shoulder hump sits higher than the rump - the opposite of a black bear's silhouette.

species.name: Pronghorn
mustRead: forward-hooked horns each with one short prong
white throat bands and white rump patch
slim deep-chested body on fine legs

species.name: Springbok
mustRead: lyre-shaped ringed horns curving in at the tips
dark chocolate side stripe dividing tan from white
white face with a dark eye stripe

species.name: Bongo
mustRead: chestnut-red coat with ten or more vertical white stripes
heavy backswept spiral horns
white chevron between the eyes

species.name: Duiker
mustRead: hunched arched back higher at the rump
tiny backswept spike horns with a forehead tuft
very small antelope on short legs
species.note: Generic - interpreted as a representative forest duiker; the crouching hump-backed posture is diagnostic.

species.name: Gerenuk
mustRead: giraffe-like extremely elongated neck
tiny wedge-shaped head with huge ears
stilt-thin legs, often reared upright to browse

species.name: Nilgai
mustRead: slate blue-grey coat on bulls
back sloping down from high shoulders
short straight forward horns and a throat beard tuft

species.name: Tahr
mustRead: shaggy mane hanging over neck and shoulders
short thick horns curving back and down
stocky goat body on short strong legs

species.name: Serow
mustRead: coarse shaggy grizzled coat with a neck mane
short straight backswept spike horns
large donkey-like ears on a heavy blunt head
